nodes.label: Brand Identity (Caduceus & Ember Line)
nodes.rationale: Owner-mandated caduceus (staff of Hermes) logo paired with a single recurring ember-line orange gradient divider motif (from-transparent via-primary to-transparent) for consistent brand recognition.

nodes.label: Cross-Module Contracts & Topological Module Registry
nodes.rationale: Defines narrow internal/contracts interfaces (AuthVerifier, KeyValidator, ProviderResolver, GatewayInterceptor, UsageRecorder, ProxyDialerResolver) and a deterministic Kahn-sorted lifecycle Registry with cycle/missing-dep rejection and automatic rollback on StartAll failure.

nodes.label: Streaming HTTP/2 Client Pool & Panic-Safe Job Runner
nodes.norm_label: streaming http/2 client pool & panic-safe job runner
nodes.rationale: Configures HTTP/2 upstream pooling with ResponseHeaderTimeout and Timeout: 0 so long SSE streams are bounded only by context cancellation, alongside a periodic job runner using defer recover() and WaitGroup shutdown.

nodes.label: Chi HTTP Server, Streaming Timeout Split & SPA Static Handler
nodes.norm_label: chi http server, streaming timeout split & spa static handler
nodes.rationale: Isolates /api/* (chi middleware.Timeout + AuthVerifier + JSON 404) from timeout-exempt /v1/* and /v1beta/* streaming routes (WriteTimeout: 0) while serving embedded static UI assets with immutable /_next/static/* caching and no-store HTML fallback.

nodes.label: Structured Logging RingBuffer & Non-Blocking EventBus
nodes.rationale: Pairs a mutex-protected slog JSON tee circular RingBuffer with a non-blocking pub/sub Bus that drops excess events for slow subscribers so stalled consumers never deadlock the gateway hot path.

nodes.label: Platform Config Loader (internal/platform/config)
nodes.rationale: Parses OMEG4MON_* env vars and CLI flags, validates ports, accurately classifies loopback vs non-loopback hosts for remote-bind security, and rejects attempts to disable core modules.

nodes.label: Platform Crypto Vault, Bcrypt & Session Signer
nodes.norm_label: platform crypto vault, bcrypt & session signer
nodes.rationale: Provides atomic 0600 master.key creation, AES-256-GCM v1 encryption, bcrypt password hashing, and HMAC-SHA256 SessionSigner failing closed with typed errors on corrupt ciphertext, malformed keys, or tampered/expired cookies.

nodes.label: Platform SQLite Split-Pool DB & Modular Migrator
nodes.norm_label: platform sqlite split-pool db & modular migrator
nodes.rationale: Implements zero-CGO modernc.org/sqlite WAL engine with 1-conn Writer and 8-conn Reader pools plus transactional MigrateModule that rolls back atomically on failed SQL scripts without recording partial schema_migrations rows.

nodes.label: Single-Binary EmbedUI Pipeline, Makefile & Dockerfile
nodes.rationale: Wires cmd/omeg4mon-router (buildApp, embedui vs !embedui build tags), Makefile (codegen, test, build-web, build, cross-build), and multi-stage Bun -> Go -> distroless Dockerfile to ship a single zero-CGO executable.

nodes.label: System Module & OpenAPI 3.1 Spec
nodes.rationale: First vertical-slice module owning system_state migrations, public /api/health, /api/version, /api/init routes, remote-bind-guarded admin /api/shutdown, and modular OpenAPI 3.1 specs in contracts/openapi/.

nodes.label: Next.js Static-Export Shell & OpenAPI Codegen
nodes.rationale: Scaffolds strict TypeScript Next.js 16 app with openapi-typescript/openapi-fetch codegen, DESIGN.md primitives (CaduceusLogo, EmberRule, AppShell), /, /init, /login, /dashboard SystemOverview, and NEXT_OUTPUT_EXPORT toggle supporting both dev API rewrites and static export.

nodes.label: OMEG4MON ROUTER Design Direction
nodes.rationale: Owner-authored visual direction (joshz) positioning OMEG4MON ROUTER as a warm, precise self-hosted LLM gateway rather than a sterile corporate dashboard, preserving all features while constraining changes to the UI/UX layer.

nodes.label: Wave 0 Platform Foundation Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: Establishes a 10-task TDD sequence on branch migration/ts-go to deliver all cross-cutting Go platform packages, the system vertical-slice module, OpenAPI codegen, DESIGN.md Next.js shell, and single-binary embedui pipeline before Wave 1 core gateway modules.

nodes.label: Core Color Palette (1 Base + 1 Accent)
nodes.rationale: Ember orange (#E56A4A) differentiates from generic blue-purple AI tools; solid charcoal dark (#0a0a0a) supports developer ergonomics and orange contrast (R-21); warm off-white (#FDFAF6) avoids sterile white; neutral gray (#6B7280) stays outside the 1-base + 1-accent core palette (R-29).

nodes.label: Solid Opaque Surfaces, Motion Dials & Screen Archetypes
nodes.norm_label: solid opaque surfaces, motion dials & screen archetypes
nodes.rationale: Opaque surfaces without glassmorphism (R-10), minimal elevation (R-12), single focus glow cap (R-13), ENERGY 2 / RHYTHM 2 / MOTION 1 restrained hover transitions, Configure (Login) vs Monitor (Dashboard) archetypes, zero UI emojis (R-04), WCAG AA contrast (R-25), and functional controls (R-26) maximize clarity and state scannability.

nodes.label: Geist Typography System
nodes.rationale: Geist Sans provides clean tabular numerals for usage and API key tables; Geist Mono marks technical values (keys, hashes, endpoints, tokens, IDs) as data indicators rather than decorative terminal styling.

nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph Workflow Rules
nodes.rationale: Running graphify query/path/explain/section before raw grep or file reads returns a compact scoped subgraph, while AST-only graphify update keeps graphify-out/graph.json current without API cost.

nodes.label: Single-Admin Auth & Remote-Bind Posture
nodes.rationale: Dashboard remains single-admin (require_login=true by default, bootstrapped via /api/init or OMEG4MON_ADMIN_PASSWORD, HMAC-SHA256 HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie). Loopback (127.0.0.1/::1) allows require_login=false for /api/* only; non-loopback binds (0.0.0.0/Docker) enforce login and disable /api/shutdown unless OMEG4MON_ALLOW_INSECURE_REMOTE=true. Gateway /v1/* and /v1beta/* authenticate via Bearer, x-api-key, or key query param.

nodes.label: Canonical IR & Direct Protocol Translators
nodes.rationale: Preserves messages, system instructions, streaming deltas, parallel tool calls, structured JSON outputs, multimodal images, and reasoning/thinking blocks. Combines zero-overhead direct pass-through (preserving provider fields like Anthropic cache_control), direct pair translators where Canonical IR would lose fidelity (Anthropic thinking/cache-control <-> OpenAI Responses), bounded SQLite TTL chain for previous_response_id on non-Responses upstreams, and heuristic Go fallback for count_tokens.

nodes.label: CLI Tools Generator & Loopback-Only Apply
nodes.rationale: Generates copyable/downloadable configs for Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Cline, Roo, Droid, etc.; one-click atomic local apply with backup/rollback is enabled strictly on loopback and disabled in Docker/remote-bind deployments.

nodes.label: In-Process Typed EventBus
nodes.rationale: Provides decoupled async cross-module hooks, SSE telemetry streams, and read-through cache invalidation on config mutations.

nodes.label: Gateway Routing & SSE Streaming Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Serves /v1/chat/completions, /v1/messages, /v1/messages/count_tokens, /v1/responses, /v1/responses/compact, /v1beta/models*, /v1/models*, and compatibility aliases (/codex/*, /responses, /models/*). Uses WriteTimeout: 0, ReadHeaderTimeout: 10s, IdleTimeout: 120s, bufio.Reader, and http.NewResponseController(w).Flush() per SSE event; separates client 400 errors (return immediately) from provider 401/429/5xx errors (OAuth refresh, cooldown backoff, rotation, combo fallback).

nodes.label: Internal Contracts & GatewayInterceptor Chain
nodes.rationale: Narrow Go interfaces in internal/contracts/ (KeyValidator, ProviderResolver, UsageRecorder, ProxyDialerResolver, GatewayInterceptor) wired in cmd/omeg4mon-router/main.go prevent cross-module package imports. GatewayInterceptor (Priority, OnRequest, OnResponseHeaders, OnStreamChunk) lets Wave 2 modules plug into gateway without modifying gateway internals.

nodes.label: Next.js 15 Static Export & Feature-Modular UI
nodes.rationale: Uses Next.js 15 (15.5.x App Router, output: "export") over v16 for proven static-export stability with React 19, strict TypeScript (strict + noUncheckedIndexedAccess), Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui (Radix UI + CVA + cn), react-hook-form + @hookform/resolvers + zod, zustand, TanStack Query, and Bun 1.4+. Entity detail views use static route shells + query params (/dashboard/providers/detail?id=...) so deep-link refresh always serves a real static HTML file.

nodes.label: OpenAPI 3.1 Contract & TypeScript Codegen
nodes.rationale: Root contracts/openapi/openapi.yaml composes per-module fragments in contracts/openapi/modules/*.yaml. Running make codegen generates web/src/shared/api/schema.d.ts via openapi-typescript for openapi-fetch + TanStack Query hooks so Go and TypeScript never drift.

nodes.label: Pluggable ProviderAdapter & Headless-Safe OAuth
nodes.rationale: Wave 1 ships generic OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic-compatible, OpenAI Responses, and Gemini API-key executors plus 3 core OAuth adapters (Claude, Codex, Gemini) supporting both automatic local callback (/api/oauth/callback) and manual code/callback-URL paste or device-code flows for headless VPS/Docker setups.

nodes.label: Secret Vault & Master Key Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Encrypts provider secrets and OAuth tokens at rest using AES-256-GCM with a 32-byte master key loaded from OMEG4MON_MASTER_KEY or auto-generated once to <OMEG4MON_DATA_DIR>/master.key (0600), never derived from the admin login password so unattended VPS/Docker restarts decrypt credentials automatically.

nodes.label: Single Binary Runtime (//go:embed)
nodes.rationale: Packages the Go net/http + chi/v5 backend and Next.js static export (web/out/) via //go:embed (build tag embedui vs !embedui dev stub) into a single binary targeting 15-30 MB idle RAM and native goroutine SSE concurrency, avoiding production Node.js SSR and out-of-process RPC/plugin binaries.

nodes.label: Zero-CGO SQLite WAL Split Pools
nodes.rationale: Uses pure-Go modernc.org/sqlite for CGO-free cross-compilation (linux/darwin/windows, amd64/arm64) with WAL, busy_timeout=10000, synchronous=NORMAL, foreign_keys=ON, temp_store=MEMORY, cache_size=-2000 (~2 MB cap), mmap_size=0 for 1 GB RAM / 1-core VPS. Splits connections into MaxOpenConns(1) writer pool and MaxOpenConns(8) read-only reader pool to prevent SQLITE_BUSY; each module owns per-module migrations in schema_migrations.

nodes.label: Async Batched Usage & Metadata-First Retention
nodes.rationale: Gateway emits usage/log events into a bounded async channel flushed in batches (250ms or 50 records) so disk I/O never stalls SSE. Persists metadata by default (tokens, cost, latency/TTFT, status) to stay within the 15-30 MB RAM / 1 GB VPS budget; full payloads are opt-in with 32 KB per-field truncation, secret redaction, and 7-day payload / 90-day metadata pruning.

nodes.label: Wave 0 — Platform Foundation & Build Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Establishes repo layout, MIT LICENSE, docs/DESIGN.md, Makefile, Dockerfile, internal/platform/*, OpenAPI make codegen pipeline, Next.js static export shell + login, and system module (/api/health, /api/version, /api/init, /api/shutdown) verified by make test and make build.

nodes.label: Wave 1 — Core LLM Gateway & Essential Control Plane
nodes.norm_label: wave 1 — core llm gateway & essential control plane
nodes.rationale: Target of initial implementation plan (Waves 0-1): delivers core always-active modules auth, settings, providers (generic executors + Claude/Codex/Gemini OAuth), keys, combos, gateway, usage, clitools, and matching web/src/features/* dashboard views.

nodes.label: Wave 2 — Routing, Provider Expansion, Security & DevTools
nodes.norm_label: wave 2 — routing, provider expansion, security & devtools
nodes.rationale: Plugs in additional dedicated provider adapters (Qwen, GitHub Copilot, Kiro, Cursor, Antigravity) plus optional modules proxypools, translator, modeleditor, modelbypass, tokensaver, headroom, promptinjection (via GatewayInterceptor), security, notifications, and jobs.

nodes.label: Wave 3 — Extended Ecosystem, Key Grouping & Packaging
nodes.norm_label: wave 3 — extended ecosystem, key grouping & packaging
nodes.rationale: Delivers teams (Owner Decision 2A: API-key, budget, and quota grouping under single-admin dashboard without multi-user RBAC), vouchers, media (/v1/audio/*, /v1/images/*, /v1/videos/*, /v1/search, /v1/web/fetch), tunnel (Cloudflare/Tailscale), mitm, pxpipe, telegram, arena, basicchat, plugins, skills, cloudsync, one-way legacy data.sqlite importer, and cli/ npm launcher.

nodes.label: OMEG4MON Design System (docs/DESIGN.md)
nodes.rationale: Preserves owner visual identity: #E56A4A ember orange accent, solid charcoal dark (#0a0a0a) and warm off-white (#FDFAF6), neutral grays (#6B7280), Geist Sans & Geist Mono, caduceus SVG logo, ember-line gradient divider, solid opaque surfaces (no glassmorphism), ENERGY 2 / RHYTHM 2 / MOTION 1, zero UI emojis, WCAG AA contrast.

nodes.label: OMEG4MON Router Modular TS x Go Rewrite Design
nodes.norm_label: omeg4mon router modular ts x go rewrite design
nodes.rationale: Approved design specification for rewriting the legacy main JavaScript monolith (223 JS API routes, 40 dashboard pages, JS open-sse engine, incomplete 10-file Go prototype) on branch migration/ts-go to eliminate 150-350 MB Node.js idle RAM overhead, V8 GC pressure under SSE, structural coupling, and upstream decolua code.

nodes.label: Clean-Room IP Ownership & OMEG4MON MIT License
nodes.norm_label: clean-room ip ownership & omeg4mon mit license
nodes.rationale: Owner Decision 1A: builders may read main strictly as a behavioral specification reference (endpoint URLs, OAuth/PKCE params, wire quirks, pricing, CLI formats), with 0% verbatim copying of code, SQL, or third-party assets from upstream decolua code. Clean MIT LICENSE under Copyright (c) 2026 OMEG4MON with MIT-compatible dependencies.

nodes.label: Model Addressing, Resolution Precedence & Key Scoping
nodes.norm_label: model addressing, resolution precedence & key scoping
nodes.rationale: Deterministic resolution order: (1) Active Combo name -> (2) Model Alias -> (3) Explicit <provider>/<model> -> (4) Bare <model> across enabled connected providers by priority. keys.allowed_models checks the requested identifier (authorizing a combo authorizes its member targets) and filters /v1/models.

nodes.label: Modular Monolith & Module Registry
nodes.rationale: Chosen (Approach A) over Layered Monolith with manual types (Approach B, rejected due to domain coupling and Go/TS drift) and Micro-Kernel with gRPC/go-plugin binaries (Approach C, rejected for breaking single-binary simplicity). Vertical-slice Go modules in internal/modules/<domain>/ implement lifecycle.Module (Name, Dependencies, Migrations, RegisterRoutes, Start, Stop), validated by topological sort in Registry, never import sibling modules, and toggle optional Wave 2-3 modules via OMEG4MON_DISABLED_MODULES.
